_comment: Login profile (D191). Yi reads ~/.yi/oauth/<provider>.json and ships none of its own:
no client ids, no endpoints, no wire identity. Whatever this file carries is what
`yi login <provider>` uses and what every request for that provider sends.
It lives beside the token store, NOT in ~/.yi/catalog/, so the background catalog
`stream_headers` are merged over the adapter's own headers on every request, with
D170 semantics: a name replaces the adapter's, matched case-insensitively, and an
empty value removes it. `refresh_headers` go only on the token-refresh call.
You are responsible for what you put here. A provider's terms may forbid presenting
a client id or identity that is not yours.
scripts/oauth-profile-gen.py writes this file; fill in its discovery stubs.

stream_headers._: Header name -> value, sent on every request for this provider.

refresh_headers._: Header name -> value, sent only when refreshing the token.
